packageRules.description: Group each Rust-embedded npm CLI pin into its own PR; auto-merge once tests pass.
prBodyNotes: This dependency is pinned inside Rust source (see `crates/executors/src/executors/*.rs`) and is managed by a Renovate custom manager — do not hand-edit the version.

packageRules.description: Major updates carry risk a green test run can't fully vouch for — require human review.
Claude Code CLI: never auto-merge — a passing test suite cannot detect a model-alias change (this is the failure mode that motivated managing these pins).
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Model alias check:** Bumping `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` can change which model the `opus`, `sonnet`, and `haiku` aliases resolve to. A green CI run does **not** catch this. Glance at the CLI release notes / changelog for model-mapping changes before approving.
